title: Theoretical physicists at S4 had exhausted gravity approaches

tellings.quote: >> Oh, for sure. Okay. I think they were exhausted by him. And I think they they kept going over that road and never got anywhere.

plain: At S4, a secret site in Nevada where Bob Lazar says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989, the theoretical physicists had already worn out every gravity-based approach to how the craft worked. Lazar, who says he was there, tells Michels they 'kept going over that road and never got anywhere.' If true, it would mean the scientists on the program were stuck, unable to explain the craft with known physics.
